name: EAGL::Device::GetCurrentRenderContext
why: differing-name review: The getter/global pair is swapped. The global this reads (0x23fb64) is written by NewRenderContext, DeleteRenderContext and SetCurrentRenderContext 0xe8a00, exactly like PS2 0x3485b0 (render context). It has 8 callers incl. FONTEAGL_startdraw, and address order e89e0/e89f0/e8a00/e8a10 = PS2 GetRC/GetTRC/SetRC/SetTRC. Swap with item 113. (was EAGL::Device::GetCurrentTextureRenderContext)

name: EAGL::Device::GetCurrentTextureRenderContext
why: differing-name review: Reads 0x23fb68, whose only writer is 0xe8a10. 0xe8a10 is reached only from RShadowMap::Begin/GrabBackBuffer (TextureRenderContext Begin/EndFrame), like PS2 0x3485b4. 3 callers incl. Draw, like PS2's single-caller texture getter. Swap with item 112. (was EAGL::Device::GetCurrentRenderContext)

name: EAGLInternal::DevicePrivate::SetCurrentTextureRenderContext
why: differing-name review: Writes 0x23fb68 (the texture RC global, see 113), called only from the texture-render-context begin/end helpers 0xf3600/0xf3620 (RShadowMap::Begin, GrabBackBuffer), and follows SetCurrentRenderContext 0xe8a00 as on PS2.
